decision: stateful campaign captures plus bounded lease-expiry waits
problem: The Qubes campaign harness could send fixed requests but could not carry a claimed mission id or lease token into later qrexec calls, so same-worker stale-token fencing could not be exercised end-to-end from real coordinator responses.

approaches.name: hard-coded mission ids and lease tokens
approaches.lesson: Synthetic constants do not prove the tokens came from the live coordinator or survived qrexec process boundaries.

approaches.name: stateful capture/reference campaign DSL with bounded wait
approaches.latency: one intentional lease-expiry interval for the fencing probe
approaches.lesson: Reusing actual prior responses lets the VM-boundary campaign prove old-token rejection and current-token acceptance without changing production coordinator semantics.

approaches.name: add test-only lease expiry controls to the production qrexec coordinator
approaches.lesson: Test-only time controls inside the production service would widen its command/configuration surface and could make the campaign less representative of real deployment behavior.

integrationFailure.observed: DIG Node QA #169 failed only in qubes-qrexec-campaign-harness.test.mjs because the harness emitted a bounded wait event that the collector rejected as an unsupported event type.
integrationFailure.rootCause: The campaign-control event contract was extended in the harness without extending the collector's accepted event schema.

candidateFixes.name: stop emitting wait events
candidateFixes.lesson: Dropping the event would hide an intentional 31-second lease-expiry action from raw campaign evidence.

candidateFixes.name: treat wait as transport latency
candidateFixes.lesson: An intentional lease wait is control-plane timing, not qrexec transport or recovery latency.

candidateFixes.name: accept bounded wait as validated control metadata in the collector
candidateFixes.latency: does not alter measured transport/recovery samples
candidateFixes.lesson: Keeping wait in raw evidence while excluding it from latency metrics preserves auditability and metric correctness.

added: capture claim response and resolve nested $ref values into later signed request bodies
same-worker old-token/new-token fencing sequence after bounded lease wait
collector accepts bounded wait as control metadata without changing latency samples
collector rejects negative or over-120-second wait events
expectedRealQubesSequence: claim mission and capture old lease token
reclaim with the same workerId and capture a new lease token
attempt completion with old token and require rejection
complete with new token and require success

safety: Synthetic and defensive worker reliability testing only; no real financial operations or external side effects.
